phase_decisions.phase_applicability: Six named Namibian land ports for passengers: Oshikango, Katwitwi, Wenela, Buitepos, Ariamsvlei, Noordoewer. Essential trade and discretionary admissions remain exceptions; sea ports omitted. Current phase only: Namibian passenger restrictions at Oshikango, Katwitwi, Wenela, Buitepos, Ariamsvlei and Noordoewer, with essential trade and authorized admissions excepted.

date_scope_check.qualification_retained: SC21-FU1: Reuters explicitly dates the national travel ban to March 24 with immediate effect; the same-day UN account identifies the six land posts. This establishes a reported formal onset, not the first observed refusal at every gate. The initial 30-day announced restriction supports greater-than-24-hour policy eligibility, while the complete renewal chain and exact operational duration remain unknown. Essential trade and supplies, reciprocal business/trade missions, specially approved admissions and controlled returning nationals/residents were excepted. September 18 easing still required bilateral implementation. October 14 permission covers Katima Mulilo/Wenela, Ariamsvlei and Noordoewer; Walvis Bay is a harbour and excluded from this land scope. Other posts and first actual passages remain unresolved.
date_scope_check.review_limit: No dates, unknown reopenings, duration classifications or continuity assumptions changed by this geographic review.
